responsible_body: National government (Cabinet Secretary for roads; road agency such as KeNHA)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: President and Cabinet Secretary answer. MPs and Senators approve the national budget and oversee spending. MPs and Senators do not build roads.
notes: Agency names come from the Kenya Roads Act 2007, which we could not open (unverified).

responsible_body: County executive (the county department for roads), led by the Governor
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers for delivery. MCAs approve the budget and oversee the executive. Which agency maintains a given rural or urban road can differ in practice (KeRRA, KURA or the county): ask the county roads office.
fourth_schedule_reference: Part 2, para 5(a); Part 1, para 18(c) sets national standards
notes: Share of the road maintenance fuel levy for counties is still before Parliament (Roads Act (Amendment) Bill 2025). Status contested/pending.

topic: Primary and secondary schools (buildings, teachers, running costs)
responsible_body: National government (Ministry of Education; Teachers Service Commission)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: President and Cabinet Secretary answer. MPs oversee and approve national budget. NG-CDF may fund classrooms because schools are a national function.
notes: NG-CDF Act s. 24 limits NG-CDF to national functions.

topic: Early childhood education (ECDE), village polytechnics, childcare
responsible_body: County executive (county education department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs approve budget and oversee.
notes: Basic Education Act s. 26 says counties fund this infrastructure.

responsible_body: NG-CDF Constituency Committee (national), and any county bursary scheme set up by county law
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: No single person. NG-CDF bursaries are decided by the Constituency Committee with Board approval. County bursaries depend on a county law. MPs and MCAs do not pay fees personally.
fourth_schedule_reference: Not a Fourth Schedule item; NG-CDF Act s. 48A
notes: Art. 53(1)(b): every child has the right to free and compulsory basic education. County bursary rules vary by county and were not checked.

responsible_body: County water services provider (county-owned company) licensed and regulated by the national Water Services Regulatory Board
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs oversee.
notes: Water Act 2016 s. 77-78.

topic: Water resources, dams and water protection
responsible_body: National government (water authorities and the Cabinet Secretary for water)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: President and Cabinet Secretary answer. Parliament oversees.
fourth_schedule_reference: Part 1, para 22(c); use of international waters para 2
notes: Dam safety and sharing of water resources are national.

topic: Health: county hospitals, health centres, dispensaries, ambulances
responsible_body: County executive (county health department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs approve budget and oversee.
notes: Constitution lists county health facilities and pharmacies, ambulance services and primary health care.

topic: Health: national referral hospitals and health policy
responsible_body: National government (Ministry of Health)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: President and Cabinet Secretary answer. Parliament oversees.
notes: Which hospital counts as national referral is set in national law (not checked).

topic: Agriculture: extension, livestock, fisheries, crop and animal disease control
responsible_body: County executive (county agriculture department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs oversee.
notes: National government sets agriculture and veterinary policy (Part 1, para 29-30).

responsible_body: County executive (trade department); county markets
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs make county trade laws and oversee.
notes: Trade licences exclude regulation of professions.

topic: County planning, land survey, boundaries and fencing
responsible_body: County executive (lands and planning department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. Assembly approves county plans.
notes: General principles of land planning are national (Part 1, para 21).

responsible_body: National government sets housing policy; county does county housing
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Parliament makes housing law. Governor answers for county housing.
notes: Specific housing programmes not checked.

responsible_body: National Land Commission administers public land for national and county governments
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Not an elected office. Counties hold most public land in trust for residents.
notes: Title registration law not checked.

responsible_body: County executive for public road transport, traffic and parking in the county; national government for road traffic rules
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers for county matters. Parliament makes national traffic law.
notes: Boundary between national road traffic rules and county traffic management not checked in the statutes.

responsible_body: County executive
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs oversee.
notes: Highway lighting on trunk roads may sit with the road agency (not checked).

responsible_body: County executive (environment or health department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs oversee.
notes: Refuse removal, refuse dumps and solid waste disposal.

responsible_body: County executive
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs make county by-laws.
notes: Environmental protection rules are national (Part 1, para 22).

topic: Environment and natural resources (national rules); soil, water conservation and forestry (county implementation)
responsible_body: National government sets rules and policy; counties implement
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Parliament makes the law. Governor answers for county work.
notes: NEMA and other agencies not checked.

responsible_body: National Police Service under the Inspector-General (independent command)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: President and Cabinet Secretary (policy). The Governor (or a county executive member the Governor appoints) chairs the County Policing Authority, which proposes priorities but cannot direct operations.
notes: NPS Act s. 41 (Rev. 2014 text).

responsible_body: Judiciary (independent)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: None. Parliament makes laws and approves funding; nobody elected directs the courts.
notes: Constitution Art. 159.

topic: Fire fighting and disaster response in the county
responsible_body: County executive (fire and disaster department)
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Governor answers. MCAs oversee.
notes: Part 1, para 24 also lists disaster management as national, so both levels act.

responsible_body: National government sets energy policy and regulation; county does county electricity and gas reticulation
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Parliament makes the law. Governor answers for county work.
notes: Overlap between the two listings was not tested in court as far as we found.

responsible_body: County assembly approves; county executive prepares and spends
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: MCAs approve and oversee. Governor leads the executive that spends. Controller of Budget authorises withdrawals.
notes: Public participation required (Art. 196, 201(a)).

responsible_body: National Assembly approves; Treasury prepares
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: MPs approve. Senate does not approve the national budget but shares revenue among counties.
notes: Division of Revenue Bill and County Allocation of Revenue Bill are passed by Parliament (Art. 218).

topic: Sharing of national money among counties
responsible_body: Senate decides the basis (every five years); Parliament passes the yearly Bills
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Senators decide the basis; Parliament passes the yearly Bills.
notes: Not a Fourth Schedule item.

topic: NG-CDF projects in a constituency (national-function projects only)
responsible_body: NG-CDF Board and the Constituency Committee
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: Committee runs it. National Assembly Select Committee oversees. The MP is not listed as a Committee member in the 2023 revised Act.
notes: Legal status: Court of Appeal upheld on 6 Feb 2026; Supreme Court challenge pending. Contested.

topic: NGAAF (affirmative action fund for women, youth, persons with disabilities)
responsible_body: NGAAF Board and county committee under Treasury regulations
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: The Woman Representative is not named as a member of the county committee in the regulations text we read. Her role is not set out there (partial).
notes: Legal base disputed in sources; moving into an Act proposed (unverified).

responsible_body: County executive where a county law creates a fund
elected_person_who_answers_or_oversees: MCAs may be given roles by a county law but the County Governments Act bars MCAs from executive and service delivery work (s. 9(2)). Contested.
notes: Varies by county; legality questioned in press (unverified).
